summary: Baiya International Group Inc. filed a Form 6-K on July 8, 2026, announcing that its board of directors approved a 1-for-10 reverse stock split of its class A ordinary shares, effective July 10, 2026, with trading on a split-adjusted basis beginning July 13, 2026. The reverse stock split is intended to meet Nasdaq's minimum $1.00 bid price requirement for continued listing. No fractional shares will be issued. This is a routine corporate action to maintain listing compliance, not a special situation such as a going-private transaction, tender offer, or restructuring.
